items.text: Let it be. Edward took the first stone out of the wall at 06:29 — the chain works, the inscription wrote his name, and he's walking back west under his own steam. The chisel-glob bug that would have stranded him was already answered by an adjust last turn; nothing since then wants a voice, and interrupting a man who just did the thing right would only take credit for his own work.
